about: Composition rule ic-shrink-v1 (platform v8 R-10). Shared by atx-impl/tests/strategy_ic_shrink_test.cpp (the C++ rule, IcShrinkV1.SharedFixtureFractions) and atx-impl/tools/test_composition_ic_shrink.py (the fitter's rule): both must reproduce these exact fractions [numerator, denominator] to 1e-15, so the Python fitter equals the C++ rule on this fixture. Derivation (T = 4 themes, cap 1/8, intensity 1/2, floor 0): value ic {.006, .002, -.004}, mean 1/750, shrunk {11/3000, 1/600, -1/750}, floored shares {11/16, 5/16, 0}; momentum {.003, .001, .002}, mean 1/500, shrunk {1/400, 3/2000, 1/500}, shares {5/12, 1/4, 1/3}; quality {-.001, -.003, -.002}, every shrunk value negative, equal shares 1/3; flow {.002, .004, .003}, mean 3/1000, shrunk {1/400, 7/2000, 3/1000}, shares {5/18, 7/18, 1/3}. w = share / 4: a1 = 11/64 is above 1/8, capped; its excess 3/64 goes to the nine members of the other themes pro rata (their mass 3/4): each x 17/16. One capping pass.
